name: Prism Mail
tagline: Privacy-first email across web, desktop, and mobile
pitch: Prism Mail is a privacy-first multi-provider email client: a web hub for Gmail and IMAP, online desktop clients for Windows, Linux, and macOS, native mobile apps, universal synced whitelist rules, and an optional Proton Bridge connector — without telemetry or plaintext mail hosting.
features: Web PWA hub for Gmail and generic IMAP/SMTP
Online-only desktop clients for Windows, Linux, and macOS
Optional Proton Mail Bridge connector on desktop
Universal synced settings and image/link whitelist rules
FairEmail-inspired privacy defaults with no telemetry
quick_start: Clone the repo and open it in Cursor.
Follow BUILD_PLAN.md Sequential; use /coach for the next action.
install: Node 22 + npm for the web Golden Path (examples/web). Desktop (Tauri) and mobile clients land in later sprints.
usage: Use /bootstrap leftovers for Sprint 0 gates, /build for features, and /verify before merge. Branding lives in branding/product.json and design-tokens/.
